cause_quote: The Solid port passed `active={active()}` alongside `nearVisible={state().nearVisible}`, so reopening could trigger iframe teardown while the visibility snapshot still marked the app offscreen.
user_saw: Reopening a minimized Dashboard panel reloaded the MCP app and erased unsaved input.
summary: The fix makes the Dashboard MCP app renderer read activity and visibility from the same lifecycle snapshot.
reasoning: Before the port, the Lit cell synchronously refreshed visibility in `willUpdate` before rendering the reactivated app, and the existing end-to-end test asserted that the draft survived minimize and reopen. The Solid port let the renderer see activity before the visibility snapshot caught up, so the transient active-and-offscreen state triggered teardown. The fix reports that the existing retention test reproduced the lost draft before the change and passed afterward.
